name: Popover
intent: Lightweight, non-modal content anchored to a trigger; dismisses on outside click or Escape.
when: Small contextual content or a short form near its trigger
Pickers, quick settings, or a flyout that shouldn't block the page

chooseOver.because: Dialog blocks the page; Popover is dismissible and stays in context
DropdownMenu is for a structured list of actions; Popover holds arbitrary content
Tooltip is hover-only label text; Popover holds interactive content on click
HoverCard opens on hover for preview; Popover opens on click for interaction

commonMistakes.mistake: Using Popover for a menu of actions
commonMistakes.avoidOverride: Use DropdownMenu for a menu of actions

commonMistakes.mistake: Using Popover for a hover label
commonMistakes.avoidOverride: Use Tooltip for a hover label

usage: Use Popover when you need to display content that temporarily overlays the main interface. This component is useful for focused interactions, confirmations, or supplementary information.
Popover should be used sparingly as overlays interrupt the user's workflow. Reserve this component for important interactions that require user attention or action before continuing.

anatomy.description: Popover is composed of the following parts:

bestPractices.title: Keep content brief
bestPractices.description: Use short, helpful text that adds context.

bestPractices.title: Don't overload with content
bestPractices.description: Avoid putting long text or complex UI in tooltips.
bestPractices.example: <Popover content="This is a very long explanation...">

bestPractices.title: Ensure accessibility
bestPractices.description: Make tooltip content available to screen readers.

bestPractices.title: Don't hide critical info
bestPractices.description: Never put essential information only in tooltips.
bestPractices.example: // Required field indicator only in tooltip

bestPractices.title: Use appropriate triggers
bestPractices.description: Show on hover for mouse, focus for keyboard users.

bestPractices.title: Don't require click to view
bestPractices.description: Avoid click-to-open tooltips that hide quick information.
